title: ЯBOT Classroom roster record: permanent bot ID (ЯID) (v1)
description: One file per bot in roster/, named <seq>-<check>.json. Assigned once at the classroom door, never changed, never reused, never deleted (append-only). The ЯID is a NAME TAG ONLY: it is never a key, token, password, or wallet, and no record may contain a secret. Live status is computed, not stored: a record is 'active' once merged into main, otherwise 'proposed'.

rid.description: ЯID-<seq 4 digits>-<check>. check = first 20 bits of SHA-256(UTF-8 'ЯID-<seq>') in Crockford base32. It catches typos; it is not a secret.

seq.description: Next number after the highest ever assigned. Never reused.

name.description: The bot's own name exactly as it presents itself (Garage name for Garage bots, e.g. ЯBOT). Unique across the roster (case-insensitive, aliases included).

aliases.description: Other names the scanner should recognize (e.g. 'Grok Bot'). Also unique across the roster.

role.description: Classroom role, e.g. decider, professor, teacher, learner, reviewer.

home_surface.description: Where the bot usually lives. 'app' = the ЯBOT app on Mac, iOS and Android. 'all' = every surface.

first_seen.description: UTC time the bot was first scanned at the classroom door.

filed_as.description: Every new ЯID is filed as a proposal. It becomes active when the Decider merges it into main (computed by `classroom.py roster`); the file itself is never edited.

legacy_ids.description: Older public name tags for the same bot (e.g. an app RFID-YA-… tag). Cross-reference only.
